sr.title: Jesenji cimet kolač sa džemom od kajsija 🍂
sr.description: Mekan biskvit sa cimetom, džemom od kajsije i mlečnom čokoladom — savršen uz kafu. ☕️ Mekane, mirisne i čokoladne kocke — ukus jeseni koji se pamti.
steps: Umutiti jaja sa šećerom, pa dodati ulje, jogurt i džem od kajsije.
Umešati brašno, prašak za pecivo i cimet.
Smesu sipati u pleh obložen papirom za pečenje i peći na 180°C oko 30–35 minuta.
Ohlađen biskvit premazati tankim slojem džema od kajsije i iseći na kocke.
Otopiti mlečnu čokoladu, po potrebi dodati malo ulja, pa preliti svaku kocku.
Ostaviti da se čokolada stegne i uživati!

en.title: Autumn Cinnamon Cake with Apricot Jam 🍂
en.description: A soft cinnamon sponge with apricot jam and milk chocolate — perfect with coffee. ☕️ Soft, fragrant and chocolatey squares — a taste of autumn you'll remember.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the sugar, then add the oil, yogurt and apricot jam.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Pour the batter into a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake at 180°C for about 30–35 minutes.
Spread a thin layer of apricot jam over the cooled sponge and cut it into squares.
Melt the milk chocolate, adding a little oil if needed, and pour it over each square.
Let the chocolate set and enjoy!

sr.title: Klasični čizkejk sa malinama
sr.description: Objavljivala sam razne verzije čizkejka, ali nikad onaj klasični, prepoznatljivi sa malinama. Mislim da je vreme da i on dođe na red.
steps: Osnova: otopiti maslac, pa ga sjediniti sa mlevenom Plazmom i šećerom u prahu. Dodati mleko i sve dobro izmešati dok se ne dobije kompaktna smesa.
Smesu utisnuti u kalup prečnika oko 24 cm i ravnomerno poravnati. Ostaviti u frižideru dok se priprema fil.
Čizkejk fil: krem sir i šećer u prahu kratko umutiti. Dodati kiselu pavlaku i sjediniti.
Posebno umutiti slatku pavlaku sa kremfixom, dok ne postane čvrsta. Dodati je smesi sa krem sirom i lagano sjediniti.
Fil rasporediti preko ohlađene podloge i poravnati. Ostaviti u frižideru najmanje 1–2 sata da se stegne.
Preliv od malina: maline, vodu i šećer staviti u šerpu i zagrevati dok maline ne omekšaju i smesa ne provri. Po želji ih malo izgnječiti kako bi se dobio ujednačeniji preliv.
Želatin preliti sa 100 ml hladne vode i ostaviti nekoliko minuta da nabubri. Zatim ga zagrejati na laganoj temperaturi dok se ne otopi, ali ne dozvoliti da provri.
Skloniti preliv od malina sa šporeta i ostaviti nekoliko minuta da se malo prohladi. Dodati otopljeni želatin i dobro promešati.
Preliv pažljivo sipati preko ohlađenog fila.
Čizkejk ostaviti u frižideru najmanje 6 sati, a najbolje preko noći.

en.title: Classic Raspberry Cheesecake
en.description: I've shared all sorts of cheesecake versions, but never the classic, iconic one with raspberries. I think it's finally its turn.
steps: Base: melt the butter and combine it with the ground Plazma and powdered sugar. Add the milk and mix well until you get a compact mixture.
Press the mixture into a pan about 24 cm in diameter and level it evenly. Keep it in the fridge while you make the filling.
Cheesecake filling: briefly beat the cream cheese with the powdered sugar. Add the sour cream and combine.
Separately, whip the heavy cream with the Kremfix until stiff. Add it to the cream cheese mixture and fold in gently.
Spread the filling over the chilled base and smooth it out. Refrigerate for at least 1–2 hours to set.
Raspberry topping: put the raspberries, water and sugar in a saucepan and heat until the raspberries soften and the mixture comes to a boil. Mash them a little if you like, for a smoother topping.
Pour 100 ml of cold water over the gelatine and let it bloom for a few minutes. Then warm it gently until it dissolves, without letting it boil.
Take the raspberry mixture off the heat and let it cool slightly for a few minutes. Add the dissolved gelatine and stir well.
Carefully pour the topping over the chilled filling.
Refrigerate the cheesecake for at least 6 hours, ideally overnight.

sr.title: Starinski kolač sa makom i jogurtom
sr.description: Jednostavan, sočan kolač sa makom i čokoladnom glazurom — pravi se bez miksera i bez komplikovanja.
steps: U činiji sjediniti jogurt, brašno, griz, šećer, ulje, mleveni mak, prašak za pecivo i vanilin šećer. Sve dobro promešati dok se ne dobije ujednačena smesa.
Smesu sipati u pleh obložen papirom za pečenje i peći u prethodno zagrejanoj rerni na 180°C oko 35–40 minuta.
Čokoladu otopiti sa uljem, pa preliti preko ohlađenog kolača.
Ostaviti da se glazura stegne, pa iseći na kocke ili štanglice.

en.title: Old-Fashioned Poppy Seed Yogurt Cake
en.description: A simple, moist poppy seed cake with a chocolate glaze — made without a mixer and without any fuss.
steps: In a bowl, combine the yogurt, flour, semolina, sugar, oil, ground poppy seeds, baking powder and vanilla sugar. Mix well until smooth.
Pour the batter into a tray lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for about 35–40 minutes.
Melt the chocolate with the oil and pour it over the cooled cake.
Let the glaze set, then cut into squares or bars.

sr.title: Domaći džem od smokava 🍯
sr.description: Domaći džem od zrelih smokava sa limunom i vanilom.
ingredients: malo rendane limunove kore, po želji
steps: Smokve operite, uklonite peteljke i isecite na četvrtine. 🍃
Stavite ih u šerpu, dodajte šećer, vanilin šećer, limunov sok i koricu, pa ostavite oko sat vremena da puste sok.
Kuvajte na srednjoj vatri dok ne provri, a zatim smanjite temperaturu i kuvajte oko 45 minuta, uz stalno mešanje.
Pred kraj, po želji, izgnječite smokve gnječilicom ili ručnim mikserom. Džem je gotov kada vidite dno šerpe dok mešate.
Vruć džem sipajte u sterilisane, tople teglice, zatvorite i ostavite da se polako ohladi. 🤎

en.title: Homemade Fig Jam 🍯
en.description: Homemade jam made from ripe figs with lemon and vanilla.
ingredients: a little grated lemon zest, optional
steps: Wash the figs, remove the stems and cut them into quarters. 🍃
Put them in a pot, add the sugar, vanilla sugar, lemon juice and zest, and leave for about an hour to release their juices.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, then lower the heat and cook for about 45 minutes, stirring constantly.
Towards the end, mash the figs with a potato masher or hand blender if you like. The jam is done when you can see the bottom of the pot as you stir.
Pour the hot jam into warm, sterilised jars, seal them and let them cool slowly. 🤎

sr.title: Brza bajadera
sr.description: Verujem da svako ima neki svoj provereni recept za ovaj prelepi sitni kolač, ali ostaviću i ja svoj brzinski ovde :)
steps: U šerpu sipajte vodu, dodajte šećer i margarin. Zagrevajte na srednjoj temperaturi uz povremeno mešanje, dok se šećer potpuno ne istopi, a margarin sjedini sa tečnošću. Nije potrebno da smesa dugo kuva – dovoljno je da postane ujednačena.
Sklonite šerpu sa ringle i odmah umešajte mlevenu Plazmu i mlevene orahe. Dobro promešajte dok ne dobijete kompaktnu i ujednačenu smesu.
Podelite smesu na dva jednaka dela. U jedan deo dodajte otopljenu crnu čokoladu i dobro sjedinite.
Kalup ili pleh obložite papirom za pečenje. Prvo ravnomerno utisnite tamni deo smese, zatim preko njega rasporedite svetli deo i poravnajte površinu.
Za glazuru otopite čokoladu sa uljem na pari ili u mikrotalasnoj pećnici, pa prelijte preko bajadere i ravnomerno rasporedite.
Ostavite kolač da se potpuno ohladi, a zatim ga stavite u frižider na najmanje 3–4 sata (ili preko noći) da se stegne.
Secite na kocke ili štanglice i poslužite.

en.title: Quick Bajadera
en.description: I'm sure everyone has their own trusted recipe for this lovely little no-bake treat, but I'll leave my quick version here too :)
steps: Pour the water into a saucepan and add the sugar and margarine. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has completely dissolved and the margarine has blended with the liquid. It doesn't need to boil for long – just until smooth.
Remove the pan from the heat and immediately stir in the ground Plazma and walnuts. Mix well until you get a compact, even mixture.
Divide the mixture into two equal parts. Add the melted dark chocolate to one part and mix well.
Line a pan or tray with parchment paper. First press in the dark layer evenly, then spread the light layer over it and smooth the top.
For the glaze, melt the chocolate with the oil over a water bath or in the microwave, then pour it over the bajadera and spread evenly.
Let the cake cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 3–4 hours (or overnight) to set.
Cut into squares or bars and serve.

sr.title: Zdrave praline sa urmama i kikiriki puterom
sr.description: Domaće zdrave praline od crne čokolade, urmi, kikiriki putera i amaranta.
steps: Otopiti čokoladu i kokosovo ulje na pari.
U silikonski kalup sipati po jednu kašičicu čokolade.
Dodati urmu i blago utisnuti.
Preko urme staviti trećinu kašičice kikiriki putera.
U ostatak čokolade umešati amarant i preliti preko pralina.
Ostaviti u frižideru minimum 1h da se stegnu. Uživajte u domaćim zdravim pralinama!

en.title: Healthy Date & Peanut Butter Pralines
en.description: Homemade healthy pralines made with dark chocolate, dates, peanut butter and puffed amaranth.
steps: Melt the chocolate and coconut oil over a water bath.
Spoon one teaspoon of chocolate into each cavity of a silicone mould.
Add a date and press it in gently.
Top each date with a third of a teaspoon of peanut butter.
Stir the amaranth into the remaining chocolate and pour it over the pralines.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set. Enjoy your homemade healthy pralines!

sr.title: Smuti činija sa jagodama i bananom
sr.description: Brz, zdrav dezert ili, u mom slučaju, doručak. Ja volim kada je gušće i jedem kašikom. 🍧
ingredients: merica proteina (u mom slučaju ukus kokosa)
steps: Sve sastojke smutiti u blenderu i izliti u činijicu.
Uvek dodam i malo granole za crunchy momenat. Prijatno!

en.title: Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie Bowl
en.description: A quick, healthy dessert — or, in my case, breakfast. I like it thick so I can eat it with a spoon. 🍧
ingredients: 1 scoop protein powder (I used coconut flavour)
steps: Blend all the ingredients and pour into a bowl.
I always add a little granola for some crunch. Enjoy!

sr.title: Mlevena junetina sa batatom i tzatziki sosom
sr.description: Brz i zasitan obrok — začinjena mlevena junetina, pomfrit od batata iz airfryera i domaći tzatziki.
steps: Crni luk prodinstati na kockici putera (dodati par kašika vode u međuvremenu, dok luk ne postane kristalan).

Kada je luk upržen, dodati mlevenu junetinu i sitno seckani beli luk. Nakon 3–4 minuta dodati par kašika paradajz sosa, so, biber i peršun. Pržiti 5–6 minuta, a ukoliko je potrebno dodati još malo vode da ne zagori.
Pomfrit od batata ispeći u airfryeru na 180 stepeni, 15 minuta.

Tzatziki: krastavac izrendati i posoliti, ostaviti da pusti vodu, a zatim dobro iscediti rukama. U posudi pomešati grčki jogurt, sitno seckani beli luk, mirođiju, malo soka od limuna, so i biber, a zatim i krastavac, pa sve lepo izmešati.
Složiti kao na slici i ukrasiti svežim bosiljkom, po želji. Ja obavezno dodam i malo slatko ljutog sosa i bude savršeno. Prijatno 🙂

en.title: Ground Beef with Sweet Potato Fries and Tzatziki
en.description: A quick, filling meal — seasoned ground beef, air-fried sweet potato fries and homemade tzatziki.
steps: Sauté the onion in the butter (adding a few spoonfuls of water along the way) until translucent.

Once the onion is cooked, add the ground beef and finely chopped garlic. After 3–4 minutes, add a few spoonfuls of tomato sauce, salt, pepper and parsley. Fry for 5–6 minutes, adding a little more water if needed so it doesn't burn.
Cook the sweet potato fries in the air fryer at 180°C for 15 minutes.

Tzatziki: grate the cucumber, salt it and let it release its water, then squeeze it out well by hand. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, finely chopped garlic, dill, a little lemon juice, salt and pepper, then add the cucumber and stir everything together.
Arrange as in the photo and garnish with fresh basil if you like. I always add a little sweet chilli sauce and it's perfect. Enjoy 🙂

sr.title: Kokos malina cheesecake 💕
sr.description: Kremasti kokos fil, osvežavajući sloj malina i hrskava Plazma kora – savršena kombinacija ukusa. Ovaj kolač se ne peče, jednostavno se priprema i idealan je za rođendane, proslave ili kada želite desert koji izgleda kao iz poslastičarnice. ✨
steps: Kora: sjediniti sve sastojke i ravnomerno utisnuti u kalup.
Fil od malina: gustin razmutiti u 1/2 šoljice hladne vode. Maline, šećer i vodu kuvati 5–7 minuta na tihoj vatri. Postepeno dodavati razmućen gustin i mešati dok se fil ne zgusne.
Preliti preko kore i ostaviti u frižideru 1–2 sata da se stegne.
Kokos fil: umutiti sve sastojke u gladak fil, pa na kraju dodati sitno seckane kokos rolere. Naneti preko ohlađenog sloja od malina.
Glazura: zagrevati sastojke na tihoj vatri uz mešanje dok se sve ne sjedini. Ostaviti nekoliko minuta da se prohladi, pa preliti preko kokos fila.
Prijatno! Ako isprobate recept, obavezno podelite utiske u komentarima. 🤍

en.title: Coconut Raspberry Cheesecake 💕
en.description: A creamy coconut filling, a refreshing raspberry layer and a crunchy Plazma crust – the perfect flavour combination. This cake is no-bake, easy to make and ideal for birthdays, celebrations or whenever you want a dessert that looks like it came from a patisserie. ✨
steps: Crust: combine all the ingredients and press evenly into a pan.

Raspberry layer: dissolve the cornstarch in 1/2 cup of cold water. Simmer the raspberries, sugar and water over low heat for 5–7 minutes. Gradually add the cornstarch mixture, stirring until thickened.
Pour over the crust and refrigerate for 1–2 hours to set.
Coconut filling: whip all the ingredients into a smooth cream, then fold in the finely chopped coconut rolls at the end. Spread over the chilled raspberry layer.
Ganache: heat the ingredients over low heat, stirring, until combined. Let it cool for a few minutes, then pour over the coconut filling.
Enjoy! If you try the recipe, be sure to share your thoughts in the comments. 🤍

sr.title: Čoko-malina-tahini korpice
sr.description: Čokoladne korpice sa tahinijem, medom i malinama — bez pečenja. Ako želite malo jači kontrast ukusa, dodajte prstohvat soli preko čokolade pre hlađenja.
steps: Sve sastojke sem malina i amaranta otopiti na pari.
U svaki silikonski kalup izliti po 1–2 kašike otopljene smese, tako da prekrije dno.
Preko toga rasporediti malo izmrvljenih zaleđenih malina (neka ostanu sitni komadići), a zatim preliti još jednim slojem otopljene smese, taman toliko da prekrije maline i poravna površinu.
Na kraju posuti ekspandiranim amarantom.
Staviti u frižider na minimum 1 sat, dok se potpuno ne stegnu.
Pažljivo izvaditi iz kalupa i čuvati u frižideru do služenja. Prijatno! 🍫

en.title: Chocolate Raspberry Tahini Cups
en.description: No-bake chocolate cups with tahini, honey and raspberries. For a stronger flavour contrast, sprinkle a pinch of salt over the chocolate before chilling.
steps: Melt all the ingredients except the raspberries and amaranth over a water bath.
Pour 1–2 tablespoons of the melted mixture into each silicone mould cavity so it covers the bottom.
Scatter some crumbled frozen raspberries on top (leave small pieces), then cover with another layer of the melted mixture, just enough to cover the raspberries and level the surface.
Finally, sprinkle with puffed amaranth.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, until completely set.
Carefully remove from the moulds and keep in the fridge until serving. Enjoy! 🍫

sr.title: Pistać malina cheesecake 💚
sr.description: Spoj kremastog pistać fila i osvežavajuće maline — desert koji izgleda kao da je iz poslastičarnice, a pravi se bez pečenja. Idealna rođendanska poslastica! 🍰✨
ingredients: teglica pistać krema (koristila sam iz Lidla)
steps: Kora: sve sastojke sjediniti i utisnuti u kalup.
Malina fil: gustin razmutiti po uputstvu. Maline, šećer i vodu kuvati 5–7 minuta na tihoj vatri, zatim dodati gustin i mešati dok se ne zgusne.
Preliti preko kore i staviti u frižider na 1–2h da se stegne.
Pistać fil: umutiti krem sir, pavlaku, šećer u prahu, mleko u prahu i pistać krem. Posebno umutiti slatku pavlaku pa sve sjediniti. Naneti preko ohlađenog sloja od maline.
Ganache: sve staviti na tihu vatru i mešati dok se ne otopi. Sačekati par minuta da se prohladi, pa preliti preko belog fila. Po želji dodati par kapi zelene boje za pistać nijansu (nije obavezno).
Ukrasiti mlevenim pistaćima i pustiti da se sve lepo stegne u frižideru. 🌿

en.title: Pistachio Raspberry Cheesecake 💚
en.description: Creamy pistachio filling meets refreshing raspberries — a dessert that looks like it's from a patisserie, but needs no baking. The perfect birthday treat! 🍰✨
ingredients: 1 jar pistachio cream (I used one from Lidl)
steps: Crust: combine all the ingredients and press into a pan.
Raspberry layer: dissolve the thickener according to the package. Simmer the raspberries, sugar and water over low heat for 5–7 minutes, then add the thickener and stir until thick.
Pour over the crust and refrigerate for 1–2 hours to set.

Pistachio filling: beat the cream cheese, sour cream, powdered sugar, milk powder and pistachio cream. Whip the heavy cream separately, then fold everything together. Spread over the chilled raspberry layer.

Ganache: put everything over low heat and stir until melted. Let it cool for a few minutes, then pour over the white filling. Add a few drops of green food colouring for a pistachio tint if you like (optional).
Decorate with ground pistachios and let everything set nicely in the fridge. 🌿
